name: tree-select
title: Tree select
description: A select whose options are a nested tree, with search and single or multiple selection.
a11y: An input with role=combobox, aria-haspopup=tree and aria-activedescendant; focus never leaves the input.
The popup is role=tree: each treeitem has aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-selected and (for branches) aria-expanded; aria-multiselectable in multiple mode.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp open the list and move; ArrowRight opens a branch then enters it; ArrowLeft closes it then goes to the parent (swapped in RTL); Enter selects or toggles; Escape closes.
Typing filters the tree to matching nodes and their parents, opened automatically; an empty result shows text.
Selection is shown in the input as text ('A, B' or '3 selected') and a check mark, not colour.

props.name: items
props.description: The tree: top-level nodes, each with an `id`, a `label` and optional `children`. Same shape as `Tree`.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected node ids when controlled. Always an array, also in single mode (zero or one id). Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Ids selected at first when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full list of selected ids after each change.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows several selections: choosing a node toggles it and the list stays open. Default false (choosing closes the list).

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when the search matches nothing. Default "No matches".

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.
